cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: It Was Foreshadowed
cards.instruction: Turn the failure into a planned turning point by returning to earlier details that now appear to predict it.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Bring the bowls. That wobble was the start of the trifle, right on cue.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You said it was a wedding cake.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: It was, until the layers settled. I'll make the custard; you can explain the change to the guests.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'm not telling them you meant it to collapse.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Just say the wobble was their cue to fetch a bowl. I'll explain the custard.

reason: Replace narrative-analysis language with a wedding-serving interaction; A claims the observed wobble cued a planned trifle and narrows B explanation after refusal.
